match_sum.go:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	s := 0
	i := 0
	for i < 24000000 {
		switch i & 7 {
		case 0:
			s += 1
		case 1:
			s += 3
		case 2:
			s += 5
		case 3:
			s += 7
		case 4:
			s += 11
		case 5:
			s += 13
		case 6:
			s += 17
		default:
			s += 19
		}
		i += 1
	}
	fmt.Println(s)
	fmt.Println(i)
}

math_bits.swift:
var x: UInt64 = 0x123456789abcdef0
var sum: UInt64 = 0
for i: UInt64 in 0..<5000000 {
    let shifted = (x ^ i)
    x = (shifted << 13) | (shifted >> (64 - 13))
    let lz = UInt64(x.leadingZeroBitCount)
    sum = sum &+ (64 - lz)
    sum = sum &+ lz
    sum = sum &+ UInt64(x.trailingZeroBitCount)
    sum = sum &+ UInt64(x.nonzeroBitCount)
    x = x.byteSwapped
    var v = x
    v = ((v >> 1) & 0x5555555555555555) | ((v & 0x5555555555555555) << 1)
    v = ((v >> 2) & 0x3333333333333333) | ((v & 0x3333333333333333) << 2)
    v = ((v >> 4) & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F) | ((v & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0F) << 4)
    v = ((v >> 8) & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FF) | ((v & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FF) << 8)
    v = ((v >> 16) & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFF) | ((v & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFF) << 16)
    v = (v >> 32) | (v << 32)
    sum ^= v
}
print(Int64(bitPattern: sum))

builder.swift:
import Foundation

var b = [UInt8]()
b.reserveCapacity(64)
var i: Int64 = 0
while i < 100000 {
    b.append(UInt8(48 + (i % 10)))
    i += 1
}
var c: Int64 = 0
var j = 0
let n = b.count
while j < n {
    c += Int64(b[j])
    j += 1
}
print(c)
print(n)
